industry.key: P. Energy, commodities and metals mining
industry.why: Overweight, carried unchanged. Component 1 regime, 23-Oct-26 (risk-off confirmed and broadening: the discount-rate squeeze now a positioning wash-out in the artificial intelligence complex with credit leading it, bonds rallied as a hedge for the first time this cycle while the Fed still hikes in December, the US 10-year near 5.10%, Brent $111, French sovereign stress spilling into Italy, European defensives leading cyclicals on all five windows and breadth in the bottom fifth of three years; sources present 2026-W43): Brent $111 (Jefferies, 22 Oct), oil above $100 and rising, and energy led the week; energy is the hedge inside a European book against the shock that hurts everything else. Relative strength per 31-relative-strength.md, 2026-10-23 against 2026-08-21, not week on week: A now, A prior at industry level. Not Double Overweight at the industry because the industry holds Metals and mining (relative strength F now from A) and Agriculture beside the three energy sectors; Downstream distribution carries the A. Counter-case: Goldman attributes part of the oil move to restocking, two months into leadership is where reversals begin, and 13 of the 18 upstream Pool names read F on TSR/Valuation, so the market has paid.

sector.why: Overweight, carried unchanged, with the brake restated. Component 1 regime, 23-Oct-26 (risk-off confirmed and broadening: the discount-rate squeeze now a positioning wash-out in the artificial intelligence complex with credit leading it, bonds rallied as a hedge for the first time this cycle while the Fed still hikes in December, the US 10-year near 5.10%, Brent $111, French sovereign stress spilling into Italy, European defensives leading cyclicals on all five windows and breadth in the bottom fifth of three years; sources present 2026-W43): Brent $111 is above the $95 to $100 the Var Energi and OMV memos said their cases need through 2029, which is why this row is B and not A: 13 of the 18 upstream Pool names read F on TSR/Valuation (Equinor, Var Energi, OMV, OMV Petrom, Ithaca, TotalEnergies, Eni, Aker BP, MOL, BlueNord, Maurel & Prom, Seplat, Romgaz), so the market has paid for the environment's own tilt and the return from here is the yield, as the Aker BP memo said last week. No memo carried a congruence line this week. Relative strength per 31-relative-strength.md, 2026-10-23 against 2026-08-21, not week on week: A now, A prior. Counter-case: Goldman reads restocking into the oil move, and a European book with no energy at all (component 5) is the one that most needs this row to be right; back to C if Brent falls under $85.

geography.why: Neutral, carried. No source spoke to Romania this week (a source pack is present, 2026-W43, and it carried nothing country-specific here), relative strength is not graded by country, and Richard's view is G10 and Europe-wide with no country line. An absence is an absence; no tilt.
